items.explanation: meeting — đang họp/gặp gỡ, mọi người ngồi trao đổi với nhau.
studying — đang học bài, đọc sách vở.
helping the elderly — giúp đỡ người cao tuổi (the elderly = người già).
wearing a uniform — mặc đồng phục.
write well — viết tốt.
remember a lot of information — nhớ được nhiều thông tin.
work for long hours — làm việc nhiều giờ liền.
play sport well — chơi thể thao giỏi.
understand maths easily — hiểu toán dễ dàng.
talk to new people easily — dễ bắt chuyện với người lạ.
do well in exams — làm bài thi tốt.
speak many languages — nói được nhiều thứ tiếng.
cook many types of food — nấu được nhiều món.
read a map — đọc bản đồ.
video game designer — người thiết kế trò chơi điện tử (làm việc với máy tính).
helping elderly people — giúp đỡ người cao tuổi.
sports coach — huấn luyện viên thể thao.
lifeguard — nhân viên cứu hộ ở bể bơi/bãi biển.
sales assistant — nhân viên bán hàng.
receptionist — lễ tân (ngồi quầy tiếp khách ở khách sạn, công ty).
doctor — bác sĩ.
waiter — bồi bàn, phục vụ nhà hàng.
teacher — giáo viên.
lifeguard — cứu hộ.
shop assistant — nhân viên cửa hàng.
cleaner — người dọn vệ sinh.
chef — đầu bếp (chef đọc /ʃef/).

exercises.title: Restaurant, hotel or shop? (G&V Ex. 6)
exercises.instruction: Put each word with the correct workplace.

items.explanation: waiter — người phục vụ bàn → nhà hàng.
tables — bàn ăn → nhà hàng.
chef — đầu bếp → nhà hàng.
meal — bữa ăn → nhà hàng.
receptionist — lễ tân → khách sạn.
rooms — phòng nghỉ → khách sạn.
guests — khách lưu trú → khách sạn.
lift — thang máy lên các tầng phòng → khách sạn.
cleaner — người dọn phòng → khách sạn.
cash desk — quầy thu ngân → cửa hàng.
clothes — quần áo bày bán → cửa hàng.
changing rooms — phòng thử đồ → cửa hàng.
shop assistant — nhân viên bán hàng → cửa hàng.

exercises.title: Skim the article (Ex. 13–14)
exercises.instruction: Read the introduction and the article quickly and answer the questions.

stimulus.text: A summer job will give you the chance to earn money and get some work experience, as well as learn new skills. Many teenagers think that it will be difficult to find a job because they don't have as much experience as an adult. However, that's not the case at all. Many employers like to give jobs to young people because they have lots of energy and enthusiasm. Before you apply for a job, make a list of the skills you have so you can write them on your application form. Not sure which job would be best for you? Here are some ideas to get you started.
stimulus.caption: Summer Jobs — introduction

items.prompt: What does a careers advisor do?

options.text: gives people advice about jobs and careers

items.explanation: careers advisor = người tư vấn nghề nghiệp, cho lời khuyên về việc làm.

items.prompt: What will Helen Green do in this article?

options.text: explain how young people can use their summer holiday to get useful work experience

items.explanation: Phần giới thiệu nói Helen hướng dẫn cách dùng kỳ nghỉ hè để có kinh nghiệm làm việc.

items.prompt: Why is it good for young people to get a summer job?

options.text: They earn money, get work experience and learn new skills.
They don't need to go to university.

items.explanation: Bài viết nêu lợi ích: kiếm tiền, có kinh nghiệm làm việc và học kỹ năng mới.

items.prompt: How many different types of summer jobs does Helen Green write about?
items.explanation: Sports coach, helping elderly people, fashion, lifeguard, digital designer.

exercises.title: Jack Riley: then and now (Ex. 7)
exercises.instruction: Put chef Jack's abilities into the correct box.

items.explanation: Hiện tại Jack viết sách → can (now).
Bây giờ nấu được nhiều món → can (now).
Hiện nay không thể làm việc nhiều giờ liền → can't (now).

items.text: cook only one type of food
items.explanation: Ngày trước chỉ nấu được một kiểu món → could (past).
Hồi đi học không hiểu toán dễ dàng → couldn't (past).
Hồi trước viết không tốt → couldn't (past).
Hồi đi học thi không tốt → couldn't (past).

exercises.title: A conversation about skills (Ex. 8)
exercises.instruction: Complete the conversation with can / can't / could / couldn't.

items.prompt: Well, I have a good memory. I ____ remember lots of information.
items.explanation: Có trí nhớ tốt (hiện tại) → can remember.

items.prompt: No, not really. I ____ really play sport that well.
items.explanation: No, not really → hiện tại không chơi thể thao giỏi: can't.

items.prompt: When I was younger, I ____ play badminton a little bit, but I stopped because I found it boring.
items.explanation: When I was younger → khả năng trong quá khứ: could.

items.prompt: When I was a child, I ____ talk to new people at all.
items.explanation: When I was a child + not at all → couldn't.

items.prompt: In the past, I ____ cook anything very well without burning it…
items.explanation: In the past + 'without burning it' → couldn't.

items.prompt: …but I've been taking cooking classes and I ____ cook many different types of food.
items.explanation: Đã đi học nấu ăn, bây giờ nấu được → can.

exercises.title: Match the sentence halves (G&V Ex. 1)
exercises.instruction: Match the two halves of the sentences.

items.left: John works many hours, but he doesn't mind because he
items.explanation: Không ngại làm nhiều giờ vì thứ Sáu được về sớm → can (hiện tại).

items.left: Julia learnt Spanish very quickly this year. I think it is because she
items.right: could already speak two other languages.
items.explanation: Học nhanh vì đã biết sẵn hai ngôn ngữ (trước khi học) → could already speak.

items.left: I have improved a lot. I got top marks for my essay, but just a year ago, I
items.explanation: just a year ago → quá khứ: couldn't even write very well.

items.left: Jim's results are really impressive and he didn't even study that much. He
items.right: can just do very well in exams.
items.explanation: Kết quả tốt dù không học nhiều → hiện tại: can just do very well.

items.left: In the job interview, it's important that you don't forget anything.
items.right: Can you remember a lot of information?
items.explanation: Phỏng vấn, không được quên gì → hỏi khả năng hiện tại: Can you remember…?

items.left: Matteo will become a chef one day, I think. He
items.right: can cook many types of food.
items.explanation: Sẽ thành đầu bếp vì bây giờ nấu được nhiều món → can cook.

items.left: Sandra is very popular and has so many friends. It's difficult to believe that she
items.right: couldn't even talk to new people easily a few months ago.
items.explanation: a few months ago → quá khứ: couldn't even talk to new people.

items.left: I know it is simple but I need to use my calculator because I
items.explanation: Phải dùng máy tính vì không hiểu toán → can't understand.

items.left: Joseph is really good at football, tennis and basketball.
items.right: Could he play sport well when he was a child, too?
items.explanation: when he was a child → câu hỏi quá khứ: Could he play…?

items.left: Lucy is late. I think she is lost. She
items.explanation: Bị lạc → không đọc bản đồ giỏi: can't read maps.

exercises.title: Questions and answers with can (G&V Ex. 7–8)

items.prompt: A: ____ play sport?
items.explanation: Câu hỏi: đảo can lên trước chủ ngữ → Can you…?

items.prompt: B: Yes, ____ play basketball.
items.explanation: Trả lời Yes → khẳng định: I can.

items.prompt: A: Not really, ____ play many sports, but I like watching them on TV.
items.explanation: Not really, chỉ thích xem → I can't play many sports.

items.prompt: B: How many languages ____ speak?
items.explanation: Câu hỏi với từ để hỏi: How many languages + can you + V?

items.prompt: I got top marks for my English essay. I think it's because I ____ write really well.
items.explanation: Điểm cao vì viết tốt (khả năng hiện tại) → can.

items.prompt: I was so nervous last year in my science exam that I ____ remember a thing.
items.explanation: last year → quá khứ, căng thẳng nên không nhớ gì → couldn't.

items.prompt: A: Four. ____ speak English, Russian, Chinese and Thai.
items.explanation: Câu khẳng định trả lời câu hỏi → I can.

items.prompt: I got a bad mark in my exams. My problem is that I ____ remember facts.
items.explanation: Vấn đề ở hiện tại → can't.

items.prompt: I did really badly in my history exam last summer. I didn't do enough homework so I ____ understand the subject very well.
items.explanation: last summer → quá khứ → couldn't.

exercises.title: Write an email applying for a summer job (Ex. 17, 20–21)
exercises.instruction: You have received an email about summer jobs. Write an email to Simon Stone (the summer jobs coordinator) to apply for ONE job in the article (sports coach, helping elderly people, fashion sales assistant, lifeguard, digital designer). In your email: (1) say which job you are interested in; (2) say what skills and abilities you have; (3) say which skill you couldn't do before but can do now. Write 60–80 words with a polite greeting and ending.

checklist: Nói rõ công việc muốn ứng tuyển
Nêu kỹ năng trước đây chưa có nhưng nay đã có (couldn't… but now I can…)
Mở đầu Dear Simon, kết thư lịch sự + tên
Không thêm thông tin ngoài đề
rubric.sampleAnswer:
Dear Simon,

I'm interested in the sports coach job at the summer camp.

I can play football and basketball well, and I'm good at teaching younger children because I often help my little cousins with their homework. I can also work long hours outside.

When I was younger, I couldn't talk to new people easily because I was very shy. Now I can make friends quickly, so I think I can work well in a team.

Best wishes,
Mai
commonErrors: Dùng could cho khả năng hiện tại
Quên ý 3 (kỹ năng trước chưa có)
Kể thêm thông tin không được yêu cầu

exercises.title: What is in Laura's email? (Ex. 18–19)
exercises.instruction: Read Laura's email (an application for a hotel receptionist job). Which features does it HAVE and which does it NOT have?

stimulus.text:
Dear Simon,

I'm interested in the hotel receptionist job. I think I have good skills to be a hotel receptionist. I could talk to new people easily and I could speak three languages – English, Spanish and Arabic. I can't work long hours but I want to learn this. I have a lot of experience. When I was younger, I worked in a restaurant.

Thanks,
Laura
stimulus.caption: Laura's email

categories.label: No – it does not have this

items.text: She says which job she is interested in.
items.explanation: Laura nói rõ cô quan tâm vị trí lễ tân khách sạn.

items.text: She says what skills she has.
items.explanation: Cô có nêu các kỹ năng của mình.

items.text: She says what skills she didn't have in the past but does now.
items.explanation: Laura viết "I can't work long hours but I want to learn this" — không phải kỹ năng quá khứ.

items.text: She uses a good structure – greeting to start the email and ends with her name.
items.explanation: Email mở đầu bằng lời chào và kết thúc bằng tên.

items.text: She uses correct and appropriate grammar.
items.explanation: "I could talk… I could speak" phải là can (hiện tại).

items.text: She only talks about the information in the instructions.
items.explanation: Thêm chuyện làm nhà hàng — không được yêu cầu.

items.text: She uses the correct number of words.
items.explanation: Độ dài đúng số từ đề yêu cầu.

exercises.title: Correct Pablo's email (G&V Ex. 9)
exercises.instruction: Pablo's email is an application for a lifeguard job. Is can/could used correctly in each sentence?

items.prompt: "I could swim very well." (about the present)

options.text: Incorrect → I can swim very well.

items.explanation: Nói về hiện tại → phải dùng can: I can swim very well.

items.prompt: "I couldn't swim when I was a child but I learnt when I was 12."
items.explanation: when I was a child → couldn't (quá khứ) là đúng.

items.prompt: "I can also remember lots of information and instructions very well."
items.explanation: Khả năng hiện tại → can remember: đúng.

items.prompt: "They could talk to new people easily?"

options.text: Incorrect → Could they talk to new people easily?

items.explanation: Câu hỏi phải đảo could lên trước chủ ngữ.

items.prompt: "I can so I think I am a good choice for this job."
items.explanation: can (hiện tại) đúng ngữ pháp.

exercises.title: Predict the type of information (Ex. 4)
exercises.instruction: Before you listen: what type of information does each gap in the notes need?

items.explanation: Sau 'Day:' cần một ngày trong tuần (Monday, Tuesday…).

items.prompt: Time: ____
items.explanation: Sau 'Time:' cần giờ (vd. 10.30).

items.prompt: left school at the age of ____
items.explanation: at the age of + tuổi (một con số).

items.prompt: trained to be a chef in ____
items.explanation: trained … in + nơi chốn (thành phố).

items.prompt: wrote his first bestselling cookbook in ____
items.explanation: in + năm (wrote … in 2010).

exercises.title: Speaking: your skills and abilities (Ex. 9–11)
exercises.instruction: Answer each question in 20–30 seconds. Use can / can't / could / couldn't and add a reason and an example.

items.prompt: What are your best skills and abilities?
items.sampleAnswer: I think my best skill is remembering information. For example, I can learn twenty new English words in an evening and still remember them the next week. I'm also quite good at drawing, because I practise every weekend.
items.sampleNote: Kỹ năng + ví dụ cụ thể + lý do.

items.prompt: What skills do you want to learn?
items.sampleAnswer: I'd really like to learn how to cook, because at the moment I can only make instant noodles! My mum is a great cook, so I want to learn some traditional dishes from her, like spring rolls.
items.sampleNote: Mong muốn + lý do + ví dụ.

items.prompt: What skills and abilities did you have when you were younger?
items.sampleAnswer: When I was younger, I could swim really well – I was in the school swimming team. I could also play the piano a little, but I stopped when I started secondary school.

items.prompt: What skills did you NOT have when you were younger?
items.sampleAnswer: I couldn't talk to new people easily because I was very shy. For example, I never spoke in class. Now I can give presentations in front of my classmates, although I still feel a bit nervous.
items.sampleNote: couldn't → now I can: cho thấy sự tiến bộ.

exercises.title: Verbs for studying and working (G&V Ex. 2)
exercises.instruction: Complete the sentences with the correct form of: get, learn (x2), teach, pass, start (x2), fail, take (x2), finish, study.

items.prompt: I ____ my driving test last month. Now, I drive to school every day.
items.explanation: pass a test = thi đỗ; last month → quá khứ passed.

items.prompt: My older sister is ____ law. When she ____ university, she wants to be a family lawyer.
items.explanation: Đang học ngành luật → is studying; finish university = tốt nghiệp (hiện tại đơn sau When).

items.prompt: I think that it is difficult for young people to ____ a good job without experience.
items.explanation: get a good job = kiếm được việc tốt.

items.prompt: My father ____ me how to cook when I was a child.
items.explanation: teach sb how to = dạy ai cách làm gì; quá khứ của teach → taught.

items.prompt: I didn't ____ how to play a musical instrument when I was younger. I would like to ____ piano lessons, but they are very expensive.
items.explanation: learn how to play = học chơi; take lessons = đi học (lớp).

items.prompt: Many students ____ the exam. They will ____ it again next month.
items.explanation: fail an exam = thi trượt → failed; take an exam = dự thi lại.

items.prompt: I ____ my computer course last week. I want to ____ how to design my own website.
items.explanation: last week → started the course; learn how to design = học cách thiết kế.

items.prompt: My friend is ____ her new job tomorrow. She feels a bit nervous.
items.explanation: tomorrow (kế hoạch đã sắp xếp) → is starting her new job.

exercises.title: A summer job advert (G&V Ex. 4)
exercises.instruction: Complete the advert with: experience, friendly and helpful, sports, art or music, energy, long hours, speak another language, hard-working, weekend.

items.prompt: Waiter/Waitress: You do not need to have ____ of working in a restaurant, but you should be ____ and happy to work in a team.
items.explanation: have experience of = có kinh nghiệm; hard-working = chăm chỉ, đi với 'happy to work in a team'.

items.prompt: You will work ____, especially at the weekends when we are very busy.
items.explanation: work long hours = làm việc nhiều giờ, nhất là cuối tuần đông khách.

items.prompt: Receptionist for busy city hotel, who can ____ (French, German or Spanish). You should be ____ to guests.
items.explanation: can speak another language (French, German…); be friendly and helpful to guests.

items.prompt: Summer Camp Leaders to teach children ____ at a summer camp. You should have a lot of ____.
items.explanation: teach children sports, art or music; have a lot of energy = nhiều năng lượng.

items.prompt: You will need to work weekdays and at the ____, but you will have one day off each week.
items.explanation: at the weekend = vào cuối tuần.

items.prompt: My brother is working as a lifeguard ____ the swimming pool.
items.explanation: at + địa điểm cụ thể nơi làm việc: at the swimming pool.

items.prompt: My cousin studies nursing ____ university.
items.explanation: at university = học đại học.

items.prompt: I wouldn't like to work ____ a restaurant. I think it would be too stressful.
items.explanation: in a restaurant = làm việc bên trong nhà hàng.

items.prompt: I'm not working ____ Monday. It is my day off.
items.explanation: on + thứ trong tuần: on Monday.

items.prompt: I was ____ work yesterday, so I didn't watch the football match.
items.explanation: at work = đang ở chỗ làm.

items.prompt: I usually finish work ____ five o'clock.
items.explanation: at + giờ: at five o'clock.

items.prompt: My friend wants to be a chef ____ a top restaurant.
items.explanation: Sách chấp nhận cả in và at: a chef in/at a restaurant.
